title: App Review Guidelines
key_points: Provides guidance and examples across a range of development topics, including user interface design, functionality, content, and the use of specific technologies.
These guidelines are designed to help developers prepare their apps for the approval process.
The App Review Guidelines are meant to provide a transparent and predictable review process that balances the needs and interests of our users with those of developers.
This document represents the current view and opinions of Apple regarding acceptable app design and development practices.
Apps should not include buttons, text or other features that lead to external links or domains.
limitations: The guidelines are subject to change at any time without prior notification.
Guidelines apply to all apps submitted to the App Store from now until the update of these guidelines.
This document is not exhaustive and does not contain every policy or guideline for which Apple holds responsible.
asserts: Apps should be safe, provide a good user experience, and adhere to our design principles.
scope: The scope of this document includes all apps submitted to the App Store from now until the update of these guidelines.
